prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 3 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 7 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a colouring-book drawing: contours only, in one thin uniform black line on white, most of the panel left white. Draw only the people and the few large shapes of the place (walls, doors, windows, a bed, a car). People are simple storyboard figures: hair is one smooth outline of its shape, like a cap, empty inside, with no strands, curls or waves; a face has one short line each for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and no stubble, wrinkles or jaw lines; a fence is its posts and top rail, a tree its outline. No texture, mesh, bricks, leaves or fabric folds; no shading, grey or solid black: dark hair, clothes and cars are outlines left white inside. Thin black panel borders, plain white gutters. Location: Sebastian's apartment, living room, Night, warm lamplight indoors, city lights glowing through the window.
Image 1: the character sheet of Natalie (25), look S2
Image 2: the character sheet of Sebastian (30), look S3
Image 3: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 4: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 5: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 6: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 7: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 8: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 9: the prop Sebastian's phone; use only structure, material, and color
Image 10: the prop agreement; use only structure, material, and color
Image 11: the prop pillow; use only structure, material, and color
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image, by the shape of the hairstyle, the build and the outfit in outline only; never copy the photograph's detail. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Natalie stands in the bedroom doorway on the back wall in her camisole, sleep shorts and open robe, one hand on the door. Sebastian, in his white undershirt, stands one step in front of her outside the bedroom door. His phone lies face down on the round coffee table beside the signed agreement; the pillow lies at the front-door end of the couch.
Panel 1: Medium shot, eye-level, past Sebastian's shoulder toward the bedroom door. Natalie gives him a last look and closes the bedroom door between them.
Panel 2: Wide shot, locked-off, eye-level, from the kitchenette side; closed bedroom door at frame right. Sebastian walks from the closed bedroom door back to the couch and sits at its kitchenette end.
Panel 3: Close-up insert, high angle, on the coffee table. Sebastian's black phone lights up on the coffee table beside the signed agreement.
Panel 4: Medium close-up, low angle, on Sebastian on the couch. Sebastian picks up the phone and taps open the notification, his face turning calm and focused in its glow.
Panel 5: Close-up, over-the-shoulder shot past Sebastian onto the phone screen, high angle. The phone screen shows the private-banking notification on its dark background, as in the prop reference.
Panel 6: Close-up insert, high angle, on the coffee table. Sebastian's hand slides the phone face down beneath the signed agreement.
Panel 7: Medium shot, slow pull out from Sebastian, eye-level, closed bedroom door in the background. Sebastian leans back on the couch, glances at the closed bedroom door and gives a faint smile.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering.
